title: The scan lookup: unknown code is the plain not-found, a retired code gives nothing but the value
description: The administrator receives a new code. The storekeeper scans it: 200 with status not_assigned and no target. The storekeeper scans a value nobody received: 404, the same answer as for a missing path id. The administrator retires the code; the storekeeper scans it again: 200 with status retired and no target (the caller learns nothing but the value it sent). NOT covered here (needs a tenant with a record type whose scope is not tenant-wide, which the QA tenants do not have): a code assigned to a scoped or undeclared target type answers the same 404 (Elixir test resolve_router_test); the entry stays partial for that reason. Needs module codes installed. A retired code stays retired (no undo exists); its value carries the run id.
